section: Suppressing-accelerating effect of Nitrotetrazolium Blue chloride in boosting superconformal cobalt filling > ABSTRACT
text: Achieving cobalt superconformal (bottom-up) growth is significantly important. Electrochemical methods, including cyclic voltammetry, electrochemical impedance spectra and EQCM-derived Coulomb-voltage curves, were used to confirm the suppressing influence of new suppressor Nitrotetrazolium Blue chloride (NBT). In situ Raman spectroscopy was used confirm that NBT can effectively adsorb on cobalt surface. Besides, EQCM-derived Coulomb-voltage illustrates that it is more beneficial for cobalt electrodeposition at high pH.

unit_id: 氯化硝基四氮唑蓝在促进钴超共形填充中的抑制_加速效应#0003
section: Suppressing-accelerating effect of Nitrotetrazolium Blue chloride in boosting superconformal cobalt filling > ABSTRACT
text: Besides, EQCM-derived Coulomb-voltage illustrates that it is more beneficial for cobalt electrodeposition at high pH. The NBT effect on hydrogen evolution reaction (HER) was studied by LSV and chronoamperometry. Finite element simulation is used to investigate the accelerating effect of NBT on HER and convection. Suppressing-accelerating effect is proposed to illustrate effect of NBT. NBT can not only suppress the cobalt deposition but also can accelerate local convection by intensifying HER, which can in turn strengthen NBT adsorption.

Besides, the high pH is also good for the improvement for current efficiency according to our previous work [2]. In summary, the difference in terms of pH in the feature and field will benefit the bottom-up growth.

text: SEM was used to observe the effect of NBT and convection on cobalt layer [44] and the histogram of grain size distribution obtained is asserted in Fig. 7. Fig. 7 (a) shows that the cobalt layer consists of rectangular strip grain without NBT. The cobalt surface is loose and the grain size is relatively large with mean grain size about 321 nm. Although the grain size is declined to some extent (mean grain size of 302 nm), the cobalt layer is not so compact due to the rectangular strip grain after applying 500 rpm, as shown in Fig. 7 (b), illustrating that convection is of weak grain refinement.

unit_id: 氯化硝基四氮唑蓝在促进钴超共形填充中的抑制_加速效应#0060

text: Although the grain size is declined to some extent (mean grain size of 302 nm), the cobalt layer is not so compact due to the rectangular strip grain after applying 500 rpm, as shown in Fig. 7 (b), illustrating that convection is of weak grain refinement. After introducing NBT, the grain morphology turns from rectangular to sphere and the cobalt layer is compact without convection. The grain size sees a huge decline to about 109 nm, which indicates that NBT can effectively refine grain. After convection condition is applied, the grain size sees a further decline.

section: Suppressing-accelerating effect of Nitrotetrazolium Blue chloride in boosting superconformal cobalt filling > 3.5. Electroplating
text: Electroplating is carried out to verify this new suppressor, namely NBT. Fig. 8 shows the shape evolution of microvias with different di ameters during cobalt electroplating. The surface deposit thickness (SDT) and filling percentage (FP) are used to judge the filling perfor mance [45,46]. The shape evolution of cobalt layer in microvias of 150 μm is shown in Fig. 8 (a). a2 in Fig. 2 (a) shows that the deposition of cobalt at the opening and plane is suppressed obviously after being electrodeposited for 4 h. The SDT and FP is 45.0 μm and 75.4 % when cobalt layer is electrodeposited for 10 h.

unit_id: 氯化硝基四氮唑蓝在促进钴超共形填充中的抑制_加速效应#0068

text: The SDT and FP is 45.0 μm and 75.4 % when cobalt layer is electrodeposited for 10 h. The relatively high FP value and low SDT indicate that cobalt layer is of high quality. Likewise, it can be seen from b2 and c2 that the cobalt grows faster at the bottom than on the sidewalls and opening of the microvias, which is attributed to the intensified mass transfer of NBT at the opening and sidewalls, while the consuming rate of NBT at the bottom is higher than the supplementary rate at the bottom. Hence, cobalt grows from bottom to up.

text: Likewise, it can be seen from b2 and c2 that the cobalt grows faster at the bottom than on the sidewalls and opening of the microvias, which is attributed to the intensified mass transfer of NBT at the opening and sidewalls, while the consuming rate of NBT at the bottom is higher than the supplementary rate at the bottom. Hence, cobalt grows from bottom to up. After being electrodeposited for 8 h for 100 μm (b3) and 6 h for 50 μm (c3), cobalt layer reaches to the opening and the FP values are high (88.9 % and 87.2 %, respectively) with SDT for 100 μm and 50 μm being 30.7 μm and 24.9 μm.

text: After being electrodeposited for 8 h for 100 μm (b3) and 6 h for 50 μm (c3), cobalt layer reaches to the opening and the FP values are high (88.9 % and 87.2 %, respectively) with SDT for 100 μm and 50 μm being 30.7 μm and 24.9 μm. Suppressing-accelerating effect was proposed to clearly illustrate the filling mechanism of NBT.

unit_id: 氯化硝基四氮唑蓝在促进钴超共形填充中的抑制_加速效应#0071
section: Suppressing-accelerating effect of Nitrotetrazolium Blue chloride in boosting superconformal cobalt filling > 3.5. Electroplating
text: Suppressing-accelerating effect was proposed to clearly illustrate the filling mechanism of NBT. On one hand, it is NBT who plays a major effect in superfilling process because growth rate difference at the plane and in the bottom can be caused due to effective NBT concentration gradient is formed as a result of geometry limitation and mass transfer limitation (suppressing effect). On the other hand, the accelerating ef fect of NBT on HER will play a supporting role during electroplating.

unit_id: 氯化硝基四氮唑蓝在促进钴超共形填充中的抑制_加速效应#0072

text: On the other hand, the accelerating ef fect of NBT on HER will play a supporting role during electroplating. Because the mass transfer at the plane is influenced little compared with that in the microvias due to geometry limitation. The NBT concentration at the plane is relatively higher, which strengthen the HER and gas releasing process in turn further intensify the NBT diffusion and adsorption to suppress the cobalt deposition at the plane.

unit_id: 氯化硝基四氮唑蓝在促进钴超共形填充中的抑制_加速效应#0073
section: Suppressing-accelerating effect of Nitrotetrazolium Blue chloride in boosting superconformal cobalt filling > 3.5. Electroplating
text: The NBT concentration at the plane is relatively higher, which strengthen the HER and gas releasing process in turn further intensify the NBT diffusion and adsorption to suppress the cobalt deposition at the plane. In contrast, the mass transfer is limited in microvias, leading to the NBT concentration is relatively low, which weaken the hydrogen bubble releasing and in turn lower the supplying of NBT from bulk to feature. The cobalt begins to grow from the bottom to the top. The accelerating effect has a positive influence on cobalt interconnect layer quality.

text: The accelerating effect has a positive influence on cobalt interconnect layer quality. In summary, the relatively low SDT and high FP values obtained in microvias with different diameters indicate that high-quality cobalt interconnect layer can be achieved under the influence of NBT.

unit_id: 氯化硝基四氮唑蓝在促进钴超共形填充中的抑制_加速效应#0075
section: Suppressing-accelerating effect of Nitrotetrazolium Blue chloride in boosting superconformal cobalt filling > 4. Conclusion
text: In this work, electrochemical analysis methods, including cyclic voltammetry, electrochemical impedance spectra and EQCM were used to study the suppressing effect of NBT on cobalt electrodeposition. Besides, in situ Raman spectra was used to analyze the suppressing mechanism and NBT can absorb on cobalt surface to suppress the cobalt electrodeposition. EQCM-derived coulomb-voltage curves indicates that high pH is beneficial for the cobalt electrodeposition. Finite element method was accepted to simulate the influence of NBT concentration on convection.

unit_id: 氯化硝基四氮唑蓝在促进钴超共形填充中的抑制_加速效应#0076
section: Suppressing-accelerating effect of Nitrotetrazolium Blue chloride in boosting superconformal cobalt filling > 4. Conclusion
text: Finite element method was accepted to simulate the influence of NBT concentration on convection. Besides, NBT can benefit the HER, which can effectively intensify the local mass transfer during electrodeposition. The intensified local mass transfer can further supply suppressor NBT to cathode surface so as keep the deposition in plane suppressed. Suppressingaccelerating effect is proposed to illustrate the effect of NBT. On one hand, NBT can adsorb on cathode surface to suppress cobalt deposition.

unit_id: 氯化硝基四氮唑蓝在促进钴超共形填充中的抑制_加速效应#0077
section: Suppressing-accelerating effect of Nitrotetrazolium Blue chloride in boosting superconformal cobalt filling > 4. Conclusion
text: Suppressingaccelerating effect is proposed to illustrate the effect of NBT. On one hand, NBT can adsorb on cathode surface to suppress cobalt deposition. On the other hand, NBT can boost the HER and the intensified gas releasing process in turn accelerate the mass transfer of NBT to strengthen the suppressing effect of NBT on cobalt electrodeposition. The effect of convection and NBT on cobalt layer is investigated by SEM as well as convection and NBT is conducive to refine the grain size. Superconformal growth was obtained within different microvias with relatively good quality.

unit_id: 氯化硝基四氮唑蓝在促进钴超共形填充中的抑制_加速效应#0078
section: Suppressing-accelerating effect of Nitrotetrazolium Blue chloride in boosting superconformal cobalt filling > 4. Conclusion
text: Superconformal growth was obtained within different microvias with relatively good quality. The SDT values for for 150 μm, 100 μm and 50 μm are low (45.0 μm, 30.7 μm and 24.9 μm, respectively), while the FP values are 75.4 % for 150 μm, 88.9 % for 100 μm and 87.2 % for 50 μm.
